title: QK-Edit: Revisiting Attention-based Injection in MM-DiT for Image and Video Editing
abstract: arXiv:2610.17829v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) have recently emerged as a powerful framework for unified text-vision synthesis, surpassing traditional U-Net architectures in generative tasks. One key innovation lies in its Multimodal Self-Attention (MM-SA) interaction, where image and text tokens are concatenated and processed via self-attention. However, this mechanism poses significant challenges for editing, rendering conventional U-Net-based attention manipulation methods ineffective. To address this limitation, we propose QK-Edit, a training-free framework that exploits the unique attention dynamics of MM-DiTs for precise text-guided image and video editing. By introducing a novel query-key manipulation strategy, our method isolates and adjusts critical attention components to achieve an optimal balance between prompt fidelity and structural consistency. translated_title: QK-Edit：重新审视 MM-DiT 中基于注意力的注入方法以实现图像与视频编辑
translated_abstract: 多模态扩散Transformer（MM-DiT）近来已成为一种强大的统一文本-视觉合成框架，在生成任务中超越了传统的U-Net架构。其关键创新之一在于多模态自注意力（MM-SA）交互机制，即图像token和文本token被拼接后通过自注意力进行处理。然而，这种机制给编辑任务带来了重大挑战，使得传统的基于U-Net的注意力操纵方法失效。为解决这一局限，我们提出了QK-Edit，这是一个无需训练的框架，利用MM-DiT独特的注意力动态来实现精确的文本引导图像与视频编辑。通过引入一种新颖的查询-键（query-key）操纵策略，我们的方法能够隔离并调整关键的注意力组件，在提示词保真度与结构一致性之间实现最佳平衡。这使得编辑可以在多种任务中无缝进行，包括对象添加、对象……
tldr: 提出了无需训练的QK-Edit框架，通过新颖的查询-键操纵策略利用MM-DiT独特的注意力动态，在提示保真度与结构一致性之间取得平衡，实现精确的文本引导图像与视频编辑。
en_tdlr: QK-Edit is a training-free framework that exploits the unique attention dynamics of MM-DiT via a novel query-key manipulation strategy, balancing prompt fidelity and structural consistency for precise text-guided image and video editing.
